entities.name: Naděžda Kavalírová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Naděžda Kavalírová was a Czech paramedic, human rights activist and political prisoner. She became actively involved in the resistance to Czechoslovakia's Communist government. She later headed the Confederation of Political Prisoners from 2003 until her death in January 2017.
